# emoji-datasource (iamcal/emoji-data)

`packages/bridge/src/emoji-data.ts` is generated by `pnpm gen:emoji` (`scripts/gen/emoji.ts`) from
`emoji.json` in the npm package `emoji-datasource` 16.0.0 (https://github.com/iamcal/emoji-data),
licensed under the MIT License (copy in `LICENSE` next to this file). Only emoji short names and Unicode
code points are used; no images.
